per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Activity values in linked DBAASP rows match paper Table 3 ranges after WT/MDR and ATCC grouping review; exact sequence remains a preserved source_conflict because this paper does not print the residue string and linked catalogs supply it.

Tables 1/2 were not promoted to peptide activity rows because they are conventional antibiotic susceptibility profiles.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are restricted to direct paper-local DSC membrane-model and DNA-interaction assays with explicit limitations; no figure-only quantitative values were invented.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: No blocking or major issue remains in worker-2/4/6 owned layers. Remaining database identity limitations are explicit cautions, not unresolved rework targets.

Linked database rows collapse some WT/MDR and ATCC Table 3 groups; final activity records keep the source table grouping and values.
